references.text: Tappuah is also mentioned as part of the border of Ephraim, showing the geographical connection between the territories of Manasseh and Ephraim.
The king of Tappuah is listed among the kings whom Joshua defeated, confirming the city's significance in the region.
Another town called Tappuah is mentioned in Judah's inheritance, showing that this name was used for several places in Canaan.
The preceding verse describes Manasseh's border as extending to Tappuah and provides the geographical context for verse 8.
